body:
The Botswana calendar differs from the Public Holidays Act, 2006 (https://e-laws.botswanalaws.com/PDF/StatutesActpdf/2006Actpdf/PUBLIC%20HOLIDAYS%20ACT,%2017%20OF%202006.pdf) in a few places. The Schedule of the Act lists "2nd January" and "Tuesday following President's Day" among the public holidays, and section 2(1) adds:

> (i) when any of the said days fall on a Sunday the following Monday shall be observed as a public holiday;
> (ii) if 2nd January, 1st October or Boxing day falls on a Monday, the following Tuesday shall be observed as a public holiday;
> (iii) when Botswana Day referred to in the Schedule falls on a Saturday, the next following Monday shall be observed as a public holiday.

Currently:

- January 2nd is a holiday only when it falls on a Monday, so for instance January 2nd, 2025 (Thursday) and January 2nd, 2026 (Friday) are business days. Also, January 3rd is a holiday only when it's a Tuesday, which misses the case of January 2nd falling on a Sunday (e.g., January 3rd, 2022).
- The Tuesday after Presidents' Day is missing (e.g., July 22nd, 2025).
- October 2nd is a holiday only when it's a Monday, which misses the case of October 1st falling on a Monday (e.g., October 2nd, 2018). On the other hand, October 3rd is a holiday when it's a Tuesday, which the Act doesn't provide for: when Botswana Day falls on a Saturday, October 1st falls on a Sunday and both are observed on Monday, October 2nd. As a result, October 3rd, 2017 and 2023 are currently holidays.
- December 27th is a holiday only when it's a Monday, which misses the case of Boxing Day falling on a Monday (e.g., December 27th, 2022).

The yearly government notices, as published by the Botswana Stock Exchange (https://www.bse.co.bw/market-holidays/ for 2026; archived copies for earlier years, e.g. https://web.archive.org/web/20230604204616/https://www.bse.co.bw/market-holidays/ for 2023), list January 2nd and the Tuesday after Presidents' Day in every year from 2020 to 2026, January 3rd in 2022 and 2023, and October 2nd but not October 3rd in 2023. October 2nd, 2018 is listed as a holiday by the Botswana embassy in Washington (https://www.botswanaembassy.org/print/2135), and December 27th, 2022 by the Botswana mission in Geneva (https://web.archive.org/web/20230929232742/https://botswanamission.ch/public-holidays/).

This changes the rules accordingly and updates the class docs. It also adds May 15th, 2026, which was declared a one-off public holiday under section 3 of the Act in honour of former president Festus Mogae; the BSE was closed that day (https://www.bse.co.bw/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/120526-PUBLIC-NOTICE_FRIDAY-15-MAY-2026-DECLARED-PUBLIC-HOLIDAY-AND-NON-TRADING-DAY-ON-THE-BSE.pdf).

With the change, the weekday holidays in the calendar for 2020-2026 match the BSE lists, except for December 27th, 2021 and December 27th, 2022, which aren't in the BSE lists but follow from provisos (i) and (ii); the first one was already in the calendar.

The Botswana test now checks the dates above. The new checks fail on master and pass with the change; the other calendar tests still pass.
